verdict.rationale: Runpod has a dedicated security-and-compliance reference page. It covers all three parts of the story: Secure Cloud partners hold SOC 2, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS certifications, Secure Cloud runs in T3/T4 data centers, and workloads get containerized isolation that keeps other tenants away from customer data. The certifications are described as belonging to the infrastructure partners rather than Runpod itself, and data-handling detail stops at isolation. missing for 10: evidence that Runpod itself holds SOC 2 or offers report/trust-center access, deeper data-handling documentation (encryption, retention, residency), and independent corroboration.
